paragraphs.text: 1. THE Bull hath yielded for the Bull the milk of heaven: the Son of Aditi can never be deceived.
paragraphs.original: वृषा वृष्णे दुदुहे दोहसा दिवः पयांसि यह्वो अदितेरदाभ्यः ।
paragraphs.translit: vṛṣā vṛṣṇe duduhe dohasā divaḥ payāṃsi yahvo aditeradābhyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: According to his wisdom Varuna knoweth all: may he, the Holy, hallow times for sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: विश्वं स वेद वरुणो यथा धिया स यज्ञियो यजतु यज्ञियाँ ऋतून्
paragraphs.translit: viśvaṃ sa veda varuṇo yathā dhiyā sa yajñiyo yajatu yajñiyām̐ ṛtūn

paragraphs.text: 2. Gandharvi spake: may she, the Lady of the flood, amid the river's roaring leave my heart untouched.
paragraphs.original: रपद्गन्धर्वीरप्या च योषणा नदस्य नादे परि पातु मे मनः ।
paragraphs.translit: rapadgandharvīrapyā ca yoṣaṇā nadasya nāde pari pātu me manaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May Aditi accomplish all that we desire, and may our eldest Brother tell us this as Chief.
paragraphs.original: इष्टस्य मध्ये अदितिर्नि धातु नो भ्राता नो ज्येष्ठः प्रथमो वि वोचति
paragraphs.translit: iṣṭasya madhye aditirni dhātu no bhrātā no jyeṣṭhaḥ prathamo vi vocati

paragraphs.text: 3. Yea, even this blessed Morning, rich in store of food, splendid, with heavenly lustre, hath shone out for man,
paragraphs.original: सो चिन्नु भद्रा क्षुमती यशस्वत्युषा उवास मनवे स्वर्वती ।
paragraphs.translit: so cinnu bhadrā kṣumatī yaśasvatyuṣā uvāsa manave svarvatī |

paragraphs.text: Since they, as was the wish of yearning Gods, brought forth that yearning Agni for the assembly as the Priest.
4. And the fleet Falcon brought for sacrifice from afar this flowing Drop most excellent and keen of sight,
paragraphs.original: अध त्यं द्रप्सं विभ्वं विचक्षणं विराभरदिषितः श्येनो अध्वरे ।
paragraphs.translit: adha tyaṃ drapsaṃ vibhvaṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ virābharadiṣitaḥ śyeno adhvare |

paragraphs.text: Then when the Aryan tribes chose as Invoking Priest Agni the Wonder-Worker, and the hymn rose up.
paragraphs.original: यदी विशो वृणते दस्ममार्या अग्निं होतारमध धीरजायत
paragraphs.translit: yadī viśo vṛṇate dasmamāryā agniṃ hotāramadha dhīrajāyata

paragraphs.text: 5. Still art thou kind to him who feeds thee as with grass, and, skilled in sacrifice, offers thee holy gifts.
paragraphs.original: सदासि रण्वो यवसेव पुष्यते होत्राभिरग्ने मनुषः स्वध्वरः ।
paragraphs.translit: sadāsi raṇvo yavaseva puṣyate hotrābhiragne manuṣaḥ svadhvaraḥ |

paragraphs.text: When thou, having received the sage's strengthening food with lauds, after long toil, comest with many more.
paragraphs.original: विप्रस्य वा यच्छशमान उक्थ्यं वाजं ससवाँ उपयासि भूरिभिः
paragraphs.translit: viprasya vā yacchaśamāna ukthyaṃ vājaṃ sasavām̐ upayāsi bhūribhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Urge thou thy Parents, as a lover ' to delight: the Lovely One desires and craves it from his heart.
paragraphs.original: उदीरय पितरा जार आ भगमियक्षति हर्यतो हृत्त इष्यति ।
paragraphs.translit: udīraya pitarā jāra ā bhagamiyakṣati haryato hṛtta iṣyati |

paragraphs.text: The priest calls out, the sacrificer shows his skill, the Asura tries his strength, and with the hymn is stirred.
paragraphs.original: विवक्ति वह्निः स्वपस्यते मखस्तविष्यते असुरो वेपते मती
paragraphs.translit: vivakti vahniḥ svapasyate makhastaviṣyate asuro vepate matī

paragraphs.text: 7. Far-famed is he, the mortal man, O Agni, thou Son of Strength, who hath obtained thy favour.
paragraphs.original: यस्ते अग्ने सुमतिं मर्तो अक्षत्सहसः सूनो अति स प्र शृण्वे ।
paragraphs.translit: yaste agne sumatiṃ marto akṣatsahasaḥ sūno ati sa pra śṛṇve |

paragraphs.text: He, gathering power, borne onward by his horses, makes his days lovely in his might and splendour.
paragraphs.original: इषं दधानो वहमानो अश्वैरा स द्युमाँ अमवान्भूषति द्यून्
paragraphs.translit: iṣaṃ dadhāno vahamāno aśvairā sa dyumām̐ amavānbhūṣati dyūn

paragraphs.text: 8. When, Holy Agni, the divine assembly, the sacred synod mid the Gods, is gathered,
paragraphs.original: यदग्न एषा समितिर्भवाति देवी देवेषु यजता यजत्र ।
paragraphs.translit: yadagna eṣā samitirbhavāti devī deveṣu yajatā yajatra |

paragraphs.text: And when thou, Godlike One, dealest forth treasures, vouchsafe us, too, our portion of the riches.
paragraphs.original: रत्ना च यद्विभजासि स्वधावो भागं नो अत्र वसुमन्तं वीतात्
paragraphs.translit: ratnā ca yadvibhajāsi svadhāvo bhāgaṃ no atra vasumantaṃ vītāt

paragraphs.text: 9. Hear us, O Agni, in your common dwelling: harness thy rapid car of Amrta.
paragraphs.original: श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum |

paragraphs.text: Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities' Parents, hither: stay with us here, nor from the Gods be distant.
paragraphs.original: आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः
paragraphs.translit: ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ
